_comment: Packages counted by scripts/npm-downloads.mjs. Add a line when you publish one; the script reports anything npm lists under the maintainer that is missing here, but will not count it, because a search-index gap must not silently change a published total. orchestraguard is concord-engine's former name — same project, renamed on 2026-10-17 — and is deprecated rather than unpublished, so npm still serves its download history and it counts toward the lifetime total. The concord-engine-mcp and shadowjoin-mcp launchers were published and withdrawn on 2026-11-12 with zero downloads; they are unpublished, so the registry 404s them and the script would throw.
